subject: a sea turtle above white sand
art_direction: 小海龟从画面下方平静游过，白沙上留下柔软影子和淡淡水纹。

composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Illustrate one sea turtle swimming diagonally away across a shallow white-sand lagoon, positioned in the lower half. Keep its flippers relaxed and its shell patterns refined but not overly contrasty. A soft shadow falls beneath it, broken by delicate water ripples. Pale turquoise light opens into a quiet distance, making the scene feel unhurried, clear and expansive. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
